meta.method: Each VIIRS detection is assigned to the nearest ledger site within 1.0 km. A night counts as detected when a night-time pass (daynight N) hit the site. Nights in the window = UTC dates covered by the files pulled (rolling 30). FIRMS does not report cloud per site, so cloudy nights count as non-detections and live_nights_detected_pct is a lower bound on the share of clear nights.
